description: Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs is a dataset listed in Datenportal Kanton Schwyz open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für öffentlichen Verkehr Kanton Schwyz. Abbildung aller Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs im Kanton Schwyz (Bus, Eisenbahn, Luftseilbahn und Schiff). Coverage: Canton of Schwyz. The portal files it under Raum und Umwelt. Its keywords are seilbahn, offentlicher-verkehr, schiff, eisenbahn, Bus, haltestellen. The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-sz-ch-portal.
